test_title: PYST 50: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The statement below has been given with bracketed text. Select the option with correct Idiom for the bracketed text.

That's just like Julie - always (coming to conclusions too quickly) even before she knows the facts.
solution:
The correct answer is "**jumping in with both feet**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, Julie is being accused of making conclusions too quickly.**
 
• Now, among the given options, the correct idiom to fit in the sentence is "jumping in with both feet."
 
 
• **This idiom means to act quickly without thinking things through.** (चीज़ों पर बिना सोचे-समझे तुरंत कार्य करना।)
 
• Example: Resist the temptation to do the minimum until you know more and, instead, jump in with both feet.
 
 
 
• Thus, the idiom in opttion1 is the correct answer and fits the context of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "raring to go", means eager and enthusiastic to start something.(जाने के लिए तत्पर)
 
• Option 3, "sailing in the same boat", means to be in the same difficult situation as someone else.(एक साथ एक ही कठिन परिस्थिति में रहना)
 
• Option 4, "biting her own tongue", means to refrain from speaking one's mind.(खुलकर बोलने से बचें)

32:T70d,

The correct answer is "**do a lot of**".
